1.title: Consolidations & Financial Reporting Manager
1.description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Consolidations & Financial Reporting Manager to our Finance team in the United States !

Reporting to the Corporate Controller and working closely with our external reporting team, this person will lead the use of AI and automation across our accounting and reporting processes, redesigning how we close, consolidate, report, and document so the work is faster, more automated, and well controlled. A key focus will be supporting the preparation of our quarterly and annual external financial statements and disclosures. The role also supports technical accounting and SOX compliance and owns our global financial consolidation. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.

YOUR IMPACT

• Lead AI automation and adoption across accounting and reporting processes: identify high-volume manual work, automate it with AI tools and agents (such as reconciliations, flux analysis, data aggregation, disclosure tie-outs, and first drafts of memos) with appropriate review over AI-generated output, and help the Accounting team adopt these practices.

• Build, document, and maintain AI-enabled workflows and reporting automation, including in Pigment and NetSuite, and track the time saved and quality improvements they deliver.

• Support the external reporting team in preparing quarterly and annual financial statements and footnote disclosures, including populating and tying out financial statement tables, maintaining supporting schedules, and coordinating inputs from Accounting, FP&A, and other teams.

• Prepare supporting analyses for external reporting, such as flux and variance explanations, key metric reconciliations, and disclosure checklists, ensuring internally reported figures reconcile to externally reported results.

• Support technical accounting by researching accounting questions, preparing recurring memos and analyses (such as capitalized software and impairment assessments), supporting updates to the accounting policy library, and assessing the reporting impact of new accounting standards.

• Support SOX compliance, including the design, documentation, operation, and remediation of internal controls over financial reporting, partnering with Internal Controls and process owners.

• Perform independent reviews of financial reporting schedules, disclosures, and reporting packages to maintain appropriate segregation of duties.

• Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual global consolidation process across a multinational, multicurrency entity structure, including intercompany eliminations and foreign currency translation.

• Own lease accounting under ASC 842.

• Support the accounting integration and system migration of acquired entities.

• Support debt covenant compliance reporting and coordinate with internal and external auditors on reporting and control requests.

• Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

• A hands-on, daily user of AI tools such as Gemini, Claude, or ChatGPT, with concrete examples of work you have automated or redesigned with them.

• Experience building your own AI workflows or agents, for example with Claude Code or Codex, to automate recurring work such as intercompany eliminations, consolidation tie-outs or disclosure checklists is a strong plus.

• SEC reporting experience, including preparing or supporting quarterly and annual financial statements and footnote disclosures for a public company.

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA preferred

• 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, with a combination of Big 4 public accounting and public company industry experience preferred.

• Strong U.S. GAAP knowledge, including experience researching and documenting accounting conclusions.

• Working knowledge of SOX 404 and internal control over financial reporting.

• Hands-on experience with financial consolidations in a multinational, multicurrency environment.

• Experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP; experience with Pigment or similar tools, disclosure management software (such as Workiva or ActiveDisclosure), or SQL/Python a plus.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and flexibility to work in a fast-growing, exciting, and agile business.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience with AI tools, SEC reporting, and accounting are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

In New York, California, Colorado, Massachusetts, and Washington, the annual base salary range for this role is $84,919 - $117,942 . The base salary range for other locations may vary. Actual base salary will be dependent on geographic location, relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and/or other job-related factors. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in either our annual bonus plan or a sales incentive plan, and our performance-based stock option program.

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold-level membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and vision insurance. Access to telehealth, care concierge, and an Employee Assistance Program.

FINANCIAL WELLNESS: Plan for your future with 401(k) match, short-term and long-term disability, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

• Our US HQ is in New York City. We are currently set up to hire in California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Massachusetts, Missouri, North Carolina, New Jersey, New Hampshire, New York, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days PTO per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!)

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer up to 12 weeks 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. For parents giving birth, we offer up to 18 weeks paid leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while you get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube !

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

2.title: Technical Recruiter
2.description:
At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

Technical Recruiter

Compass is looking for a Technical Recruiter who will drive the Company’s talent acquisition strategy for our growing teams across Engineering, Data, and Product. As our Technical Recruiter, you’ll partner with hiring managers and Talent Acquisition to develop, drive, and manage sourcing/recruiting strategies for our technical positions. In addition, you will assist in developing and promoting the Compass culture internally and externally.

Please note that this is an in-office role.

At Compass You Will:

• Manage and drive the full recruitment life cycle by sourcing, reviewing resumes, coordinating screenings and interviews, and assisting in determining the suitability of applicants in various departments for employment

• Work with Compass hiring managers to better understand each department’s needs and screen incoming applicants quickly and effectively

• Proactively source active and passive candidates through employee referrals, networking, internal databases, and innovative research tactics

• Communicate with candidates professionally and be immediately responsive

• Promote the Compass brand and use creativity to attract and market the Company to qualified and strong candidates

• 3+ years of experience recruiting and sourcing engineers

• Experience managing technical candidate pipelines

• Excellent oral and written communication skills

• Meticulous attention to detail and organizational skills

• B.A. or B.S. with a strong academic record

• Must be able to multi-task and manage a robust/full pipeline with efficiency and constant attention

• High level of interpersonal skills and strong ability to engage both active and passive candidates

• Comfort leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to improve sourcing, research, outreach, and recruiting workflows; curiosity and willingness to experiment with new tools and approaches

• Considerable skill in interviewing techniques

• Experience with Greenhouse (or other relevant Applicant Tracking Systems) and LinkedIn Recruiter

• Proficiency in a variety of computer software applications, especially Google Suite

Compensation: The base pay range for this position is $120,000-$130,000; however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Bonuses and restricted stock units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits. Base pay is based on market location. Minimum wage for the position will always be met.

Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). Plus paid vacation, holidays, sick time, parental leave, and recharge leave; medical, tele-health, dental and vision benefits; 401(k) plan; flexible spending accounts (FSAs); commuter program; life and disability insurance; Maven (a support system for new parents); Carrot (fertility benefits); UrbanSitter (caregiver referral network); Employee Assistance Program; and pet insurance.

Do your best work, be your authentic self.

At Compass, we believe that everyone deserves to find their place in the world — a place where they feel like they belong, where they can be their authentic selves, where they can thrive. Our collaborative, energetic culture is grounded in our Compass Entrepreneurship Principles and our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, growth and mobility. As an equal opportunity employer, we offer competitive compensation packages, robust benefits and professional growth opportunities aimed at helping to improve our employees' lives and careers.

Pilot has spent years providing reliable back office services to over 3,000 businesses so they can focus on running their business. 17.title: Vice President, Finance
17.description: Who We Are Imagine Pediatrics is a tech enabled, pediatrician led medical group reimagining care for children with special health care needs. We deliver 24/7 virtual first and in home medical, behavioral, and social care, working alongside families, providers, and health plans to break down barriers to quality care. We do not replace existing care teams; we enhance them, providing an extra layer of support with compassion, creativity, and an unwavering commitment to children with medical complexity. What You’ll Do As Vice President of Finance, you will serve as a key member of the senior leadership team and trusted partner to the CFO, helping shape the Company's financial strategy, operating performance, and long-term growth. You will lead Finance, overseeing planning, forecasting, performance management, strategic finance, and business analytics while providing that support decision-making across the enterprise. Working closely with leaders across Operations, Clinical, Growth, Accounting, Actuarial Services, and BD, you will drive enterprise decision-making through data-driven insights, disciplined resource allocation, and rigorous performance management. As an extension of the CFO, you will regularly engage with executives, the Board, investors, and lenders while helping build the people, processes, and capabilities needed to support a high-growth healthcare organization. Over time, this individual will assume increasingly broad enterprise leadership responsibilities and serve as a key member of the Company's future leadership bench. You will: Serve as a strategic partner to the CFO, executive leadership team, Board, investors, and lenders, translating enterprise strategy into financial plans and measurable outcomes. Provide financial leadership and performance visibility across the organization, identifying risks, opportunities, and key business drivers. Own enterprise financial visibility, ensuring leaders have timely and actionable insights into business performance, emerging risks, growth opportunities, and key strategic tradeoffs. Prepare and deliver executive-ready financial updates, Board presentations, investor communications, lender reporting, and strategic recommendations. Partner with the CFO on capital strategy, financing and refinancing activities, corporate transactions, and other strategic initiatives. Represent the Finance organization in executive and external forums as an extension of the CFO. Maintain strong financial controls, governance, audit readiness, regulatory compliance, and risk management practices. FP&A, Strategic Planning, & Performance Management Lead the Company's financial planning, forecasting, performance management, and strategic decision-support processes. Own the Company's integrated financial model, including long-range planning, scenario analysis, liquidity forecasting, and capital allocation recommendations. Build scalable reporting, analytics, KPI frameworks, dashboards, and performance management capabilities. Oversee forecasting and performance reporting for value-based care and risk-based arrangements, translating complex financial and actuarial data into actionable business insights. Partner closely with Accounting and Actuarial leadership to ensure alignment across financial planning, reporting, cash flow management, medical cost forecasting, and enterprise performance management. Develop scalable investment evaluation, ROI, and capital allocation frameworks that promote disciplined decision-making and accountability. Drive the evolution of budgeting and resource allocation processes to improve transparency, spending discipline, and alignment with strategic priorities. Strengthen financial systems, processes, and governance practices to support growth, scalability, and data-driven decision-making. Strategic Growth & Enterprise Initiatives Evaluate market expansion, payer partnerships, strategic investments, and other growth opportunities through rigorous financial analysis and business case development. Lead financial evaluation of major enterprise initiatives, including clinical programs, care model innovations, technology investments, workforce strategies, and operational transformation efforts. Support future M&A, JV, debt, or other strategic transactions, including financial diligence, valuation, integration planning, and post-transaction performance assessment. Assess and recommend improvements to organizational capabilities, business processes, operating models, and systems infrastructure required to support continued growth and scalability. Team Leadership & Organizational Development Recruit, develop, mentor, and lead a high-performing Finance organization, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Build organizational capabilities, scalable processes, and leadership bench strength to support future growth. Raise the analytical and strategic capabilities of the Finance team while promoting collaboration, intellectual curiosity, ownership, and strong partnership across functions. Develop deep expertise in the organization's financial, operational, clinical, actuarial, and strategic drivers, assuming progressively broader enterprise leadership responsibilities and serving as a key member of the company's future leadership bench. What You Bring & How You Qualify First and foremost, you're passionate and committed to reimagining pediatric health care and creating a world where every child with special health care needs gets the care and support they deserve. Things change quickly in a start-up environment; you accept that and update and pressure-test your assumptions rather than defending old ones. In this role, you will need: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related field; MBA, CPA, CFA, or similar advanced credential preferred. 10–15+ years of progressive experience in finance leadership roles, including strategic finance, FP&A, investment banking, consulting, private equity, corporate development, or related fields. Proven experience leading enterprise planning, forecasting, performance management, and strategic decision-support functions. Healthcare experience preferred, particularly within provider, payer, healthcare services, value-based care, or risk-bearing organizations. Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders and drive enterprise decision-making through rigorous financial analysis and business insight. CompTech Computer Technologies is seeking an IT Service Desk Specialist – Level I to provide technical support in support of the Defense Health Agency (DHA). The ideal candidate will have a strong customer-service mindset, hands-on troubleshooting experience, and the ability to diagnose and resolve common technical issues while accurately documenting incidents and following established support procedures.

• Communicate clearly and professionally with customers throughout the troubleshooting and resolution process.

• Provide timely status updates and ensure customers understand next steps when an issue requires escalation.

• Maintain a customer-focused approach while supporting users with varying levels of technical proficiency.

• Adhere to applicable security policies, procedures, and organizational standards.

• Two (2) years of progressive experience in IT technical support, help desk, service desk, desktop support, or a related discipline demonstrating the required level of proficiency.

• Experience using a ticketing or IT service management system to log, track, document, and manage technical support requests.

• Ability to follow established technical procedures and incident-resolution processes.

• Strong customer service, communication, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to clearly communicate technical information to both technical and non-technical users.

Education:

Certifications – You must already hold one in order to be considered.

62.title: Senior Software Engineer II
62.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Recovering entrepreneur? Frustrated with bureaucracy? Want to write the roadmap, not inherit one?

We're hiring across multiple levels and verticals. The nice thing about growing 30%+ at ~$2B ARR is that we need great engineers everywhere, and we have the room to shape the role around the right person. You build like a founder. We give you the platform to do it at scale.

About the role:

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.

We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.

We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.

This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.

• You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.

• You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.

• You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.

• You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.

In this role, you will:

• Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.

• Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.

• Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.

• Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.

• Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.

• Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• 8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.

• Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.

• Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).

• Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.

• Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.

An ideal candidate also has:

• Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.

• Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.

• Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.

• A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.

• Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. Flexible Working

Belonging at Samsara

Our Commitment to Authenticity

96.title: Product Manager, Identity & Access Management
96.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team IAM is the nerve center of Stripe. We control how millions of businesses grant access to their account, including employees, AI agents, apps, and API integrations, across the Dashboard, API, CLI, and MCP. We're also a platform team, building the unified, fine-grained permissions model that every product at Stripe builds on. AI agents are changing how businesses operate, and how they get authorized, governed, and secured is being defined right now—largely by us. We’re tackling challenging and unsolved problems for real businesses, like how to model agents when they blur the line between acting on behalf of a human vs. standalone principals, or how to authorize entire agent workflows rather than step-by-step actions. We’re collaborating directly with the frontier AI labs on the evolution of MCP, new identity protocols, and agent integrations. We build for solo founders and Fortune 500s alike, and the tension between those two is where the real product work lives. What you’ll do You'll set the vision and drive the roadmap for how every principal, human, agent, or app, gets access to a Stripe account. You'll do it by talking directly to the founders, admins, and developers who use it. Design the experience of granting access, everywhere. Signing up, inviting a teammate, creating an API key, authorizing an agent or a third-party app. Design for agents specifically. Design for agents as a new principal within Stripe, including how they authenticate, what they're allowed to do, and how businesses stay in control, including approvals and human-in-the-loop checkpoints for actions involving real money. You're defining an experience that will set the industry standard. Drive least privilege, made easy. Take holistic ownership across Stripe to ensure that every user, app and agent has only the permissions it requires. Build custom roles, smart permission defaults, and permission recommendations based on real API usage to make least-privilege authorization easy rather than tedious. Push toward a world without secrets. Make secretless authentication (Workload Identity Federation) the default way developers integrate with Stripe to prevent emerging security threats from increasingly sophisticated and AI-powered attackers. Partner across all of Stripe. Pitch an ambitious vision, then get teams across Dashboard, API Platform, Security, Payments and Money Movement genuinely excited to build it with you. Who you are The hardest part of this job, and the most fun, is the constant trade-off: usability vs. security, flexibility vs. simplicity. It takes taste to find a shape that feels effortless for a solo founder and holds up at Fortune 500 scale. Minimum requirements 5+ years in PM, shipping platform or infrastructure products that other teams build on Background in security, identity, auth, or developer platforms, or serious curiosity about the space A habit of talking to users to find the real problem, not the reported one Technical fluency to go deep with engineers on authorization and authentication design A bias toward experimentation over big-bang launches Comfort setting direction in a space that's still being invented, across teams you don't manage

91.description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You and The Role

As the PLM & Configuration Lead on our Configuration & Change Management team, you will define and own the configuration management framework that ensures product integrity from early engineering development through mass production and field operations. You will set the strategic direction for how we identify parts, structure bills of materials, manage complex configurations, and govern product releases so hardware changes are accurate, traceable, and ready for implementation.

You will serve as the authoritative voice on BOM governance and configuration baseline control, partnering closely with Hardware Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Program Management, and Field Service teams. You will make foundational decisions about part definitions, configuration and variant management, and the relationships between engineering, manufacturing, and service BOMs.

This is a strategic product-data and process role, not a software engineering role. You will translate business needs into functional requirements and partner closely with the the team building our configuration management systems; Application Software Engineering owns the tooling roadmap, technical architecture, integrations, and development.

What You'll Do

• Establish and enforce configuration identification standards, part-numbering schemas, naming conventions, and revision control practices across engineering and manufacturing teams.

• Define multi-level BOM structures and the relationships between engineering BOMs, manufacturing BOMs, and service BOMs.

• Establish standards for BOM accuracy, revisions, alternates, effectivity, and traceability across design, manufacturing, and service engineering.

• Partner with Supply Chain and Manufacturing to assess how engineering changes affect component availability, supplier qualification, and existing inventory, and define what business tools are needed to communicate inventory disposition plans.

• Work closely with the PLM Technical Lead and development team to provide functional requirements, product-data structure definitions, and business logic that guide custom development.

• Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT), validate that delivered capabilities meet the original business intent, and lead functional troubleshooting.

• Identify and resolve product-data integrity issues across PLM, ERP, and related systems, partnering with Software Engineering when resolution requires tooling changes.

• Develop configuration and change-management metrics, audits, and cross-functional improvements that reduce release errors and engineering change cycle time, improve traceability and first-pass build accuracy, and prevent configuration management from becoming a production bottleneck.

• Set configuration management standards and provide guidance to Change Analysts and engineering teams on complex BOM, release, and product-data issues, driving consistent practices across the organization.

What You'll Bring

• 5+ years of experience in engineering product configuration management, engineering change management, or product lifecycle management within hardware or consumer electronics development.

• Experience establishing and governing BOM structures, part-numbering schemas, naming conventions, and revision control processes across hardware programs.

• Deep knowledge of hardware release practices, including lifecycle states, approvals, release packages, CAD and drawing releases, manufacturing documentation, and audit trails.

• Experience establishing configuration management practices, with the judgment to make foundational decisions and explain tradeoffs across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and service.

• A strong understanding of complex product structures, variant configuration rules, effectivity controls, and the relationships between engineering, manufacturing, and service BOMs.

• Experience with PLM systems such as Teamcenter, Agile, Windchill, Arena, or equivalent for configuration baseline management and engineering change workflows.

• A track record of defining configuration management business requirements, partnering with software teams on supporting capabilities, and driving cross-functional adoption across large engineering organizations.

• Experience integrating configuration management processes with manufacturing execution systems and supply chain planning tools.

• Strong cross-functional leadership, clear communication, and the ability to make and carry through decisions with minimal oversight.

Success in 6–12 Months

• Define a configuration and variant management strategy that will enable clear part identification and revision control as Zipline scales.

• Establish Zipline’s approach to engineering, manufacturing, and service BOM structures, with clear ownership and traceability between them.

• Deliver functional requirements for priority PLM capabilities and validate delivered functionality through UAT in partnership with Software Engineering.

What Else You Need To Know

The Third Person in Charge is responsible for the operations of the entire store when the Store Director (SD) and Assistant Store Director (ASD) are not present. The position is one of the job classifications from which candidates for retail leadership development training are typically selected, the successful completion of which may lead to advancement into store management. The Third Person in Charge provides customer service, administers training to new employees, coordinates with others to determine hiring needs and to identify and select candidates for interviews, and assists with merchandising execution for the store. The Third Person also coordinates with the late shift employees in directing the day-to-day activities of the late shift when the Store Director and Assistant Store Director are not present, including assessment of daily operational needs and training personnel. Assists in ordering, receiving storing, pricing, stocking and merchandising.

• Works primarily closing shifts to run total store operations in the absence of the Store Director and Assistant Store Director.

• Works with the Assistant Store Director on center of store operations and fills in for Assistant Store Director on their days off, when the ASD is filling in for Store Director, or while the ASD is on vacation.

• Overall management responsibility for the total store operation, including supervision of all employees and the handling of customer complaints, in the absence of the Store Director and Assistant Store Director.

• Initiates corrective action as needed in the absence of the Store Director and Assistant Store Director.

• Acts as the liaison between the Store Director/Assistant Store Director and the late shift operations to ensure smooth operations of the store.

• Encourages and maintains an atmosphere of enthusiastic customer awareness with an emphasis on fast, friendly, courteous customer service. Engages in suggestive selling and other sales techniques. Handles customer relations issues.

• Performs ordering, receiving, storing, pricing, stocking, and merchandising duties. Coordinates with late shift employees/department leads in planning, organizing, and directing day-to-day operations of the store during the late shift and special sales/AD needs.
